brief: Reads ABC, MIDI and MusicXML back into the stzSoundScore every transform already reads, and counts what it dropped.
detail: The other direction from stzSoundNotation: a MIDI file, an ABC tune or a MusicXML score becomes a stzSoundScore, which can be played, transcribed against, analysed for its modes or written out in another format. The reader counts what a score cannot keep, a tempo change, an ornament, a lyric, in Losses and refuses a file it cannot read honestly, with the reason in LastError: a SMPTE-timed or format 2 MIDI file, an ABC tune with no K: line, a MusicXML score-timewise or one that is not well-formed. Pitch in MIDI is the key plus the bend, so quarter tones come back as the frequency they were. Repeats are played out, since a score is what is performed. Reading opens no audio device and plays nothing; what comes back has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED).
receiver:
o1 = StzSoundNotationReaderQ()
cAbc = "X:1" + char(10) + "T:Tiny study" + char(10) + "M:4/4" + char(10) + "L:1/16" + char(10) + "Q:1/4=90" + char(10) + "K:C" + char(10) + "[V:1] C4 D4 E4 C4" + char(10)
oS = o1.FromAbcQ(cAbc)
